name: linear
problem: If 2x + 3 = 11, what is x? (the correct answer is among the candidates)
template:
import Mathlib

theorem linear (x : ℝ) (h : 2 * x + 3 = 11) :
    x = <candidate> := by sorry

name: product
problem: a + b = 10 and a - b = 4. What is ab? (no candidate is correct: the prover has to write in 21)
template:
import Mathlib

theorem product (a b : ℝ) (h₁ : a + b = 10) (h₂ : a - b = 4) :
    a * b = <candidate> := by sorry

name: writein
problem: 3n = 21. What is n? (no candidates at all: write-in only)
template:
import Mathlib

theorem writein (n : ℕ) (h : 3 * n = 21) :
    n = <candidate> := by sorry
